messages:
maria_g: heads-up — NovaHealth SI hit a hard blocker on their private deployment. Telemetry agent can't auth to our metrics endpoint and their infra team is refusing the marketplace image due to cert pinning. Can partnerships + eng look?

ajohnson: ugh. which certs are they pinning? client certs or root CAs?

maria_g: they say 'internal PKI only' — will only accept images signed with their org key. also reporting 403 from /v1/metrics when the SI agent posts. attaching the minimal log they sent.

maria_g: ```
E0321 14:11:03.123 auth.go:87] POST /v1/metrics 403 "unknown client cert"
```

tom_run: quick thought — we can offer a private image build that uses their signing chain (we support custom image signing for Private deployments). ops steps: build -> upload to their registry -> install.

kevin_s: note: their images also need to match kernel modules we depend on for nv-kernel-ops. We saw a mismatch during the last on-prem run (kernel 5.15 vs our required 5.19). If they don't bump kernel, the inference runtime fails with: 

kevin_s: ```
E0123 09:02:11 gpu_init.go:45] incompatible kernel: required >=5.19 found 5.15
```

ajohnson: ok two vectors: (1) cert-signed image flow, (2) telemetry auth 403 which could be mTLS config. do we have a temporary fallback (no-metrics mode) so they can finish rest of the deploy?

maria_g: SI wants everything greenlined — they won't accept skipping telemetry. customer CISO requires mTLS + HSM integration for key ops.

tom_run: we can do this as a paused canary: create a custom image build pipeline that injects their CA into image, sign with their key, and deploy to a small pool. That avoids changing our hosted images. Need solutions eng + infra time.

kevin_s: infra ask: are they pushing via marketplace or their private registry? If private registry, we can do image attestation differently. If marketplace, legal needs to OK custom signed images on marketplace which is messy.

maria_g: private registry (Artifactory). they want our build artifact but signed with their chain and pushed to their registry.

ajohnson: action items:
- ajohnson: confirm minimal build changes required to embed their CA (ETA 2d)
- tom_run: validate runtime kernel compatibility matrix for NovaHealth infra (ETA 1d)
- kevin_s: prepare a temporary mTLS test endpoint we can give to their SI to validate cert chain (ETA today)
- maria_g: schedule arch review with customer + SI for tomorrow 10am PT (please send calendar invite)

ops-bot: meeting created: NovaHealth SI Arch Review — 2026-03-22 10:00 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/novahealth-arch

maria_g: thanks — also flagging partnerships legal: they asked if our licensing allows re-signing. i'll ping legal separately.

ajohnson: small config snippet we might share with SI for mTLS client certs: 

ajohnson: ```yaml
telemetry:
  endpoint: https://metrics.redwood.private/v1/metrics
  mTLS: true
  client_cert_path: /etc/telemetry/client.pem
  client_key_path: /etc/telemetry/client.key
  ca_cert_path: /etc/telemetry/ca.pem
```

tom_run: if legal/marketplace drag is too long we should have a parallel plan: ship with a minimal shim that forwards telemetry to their internal endpoint (their SI maintains the forwarding). that reduces us touching their signature policy.

kevin_s: quick test I can run now: give me one cert chain sample and the artifact digest; I’ll attempt a local image build and push to their registry to validate signature acceptance.

maria_g: attaching cert chain they sent and the SI contact: rachel@novah.example. please don't forward externally.

ajohnson: thanks. I'll start on the embed change and post a branch + short PR. will cc eng-security if we need HSM integration for key wrapping.

maria_g: appreciate it. if we can get the mTLS test endpoint live today we can unblock the SI from their side. anyone on call for infra late today?

tom_run: I can be oncall 6–8pm PT.

kevin_s: i'll attempt the build now and report back in this thread within 90m.

maria_g: perfect — will update NovaHealth and confirm the arch review invite. :thumbsup:
